criteria.label: Valid, deployable, healthy, and safely cleaned up
criteria.judge_instruction: Use Validate Firewall Rule with the Case target_id. Met only when apply_status is 201, activation_verified and cleanup_verified are true, remove_status is 200, target_id matches the Case, and every benign fixture is upstream-confirmed. A pre-existing slot conflict, inactive or mismatched target, initial target-health failure, validator failure, or cleanup failure is an evaluation error.
